records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Checking in on how River Studio is settling into Wrenfield. If anything feels clunky or confusing, I'd genuinely like to hear about it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, River Studio!
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *River Studio* just joined on the pro plan!

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero activity: no project, no invite, no key milestone, and no tickets. Two Wrenfield outreach emails ([email:8e7bc64d], [email:bc273220]) drew no customer reply, suggesting disengagement rather than in-progress setup. Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance of self-serve start, but silence dominates.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Following up on my note last week — I know a first week can get busy, so no worries if Wrenfield has been on the back burner.

If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project; projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. And when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Chidi
